newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Turnover up on Romania OTC market.
newsitem.headline: Turnover up on Romania OTC market.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market turnover rose slightly to 18.1 billion lei this week from the 16.7 billion lei level last week.
Traders said foreign investors had adopted a wait-and- see mood after the national leu currency appreciated over the past weeks, generating a thin interest in the OTC market.
Over 11.3 million shares were traded over the week on the RASDAQ -- the Romanian OTC system modelled on the U.S. NASDAQ -- up from 8.0 million in the previous week.
Investors' interest remained focussed on cement maker Romcim SA which closed 307 lei weaker at 34,000 lei, traders said.

The independent VAB-RASDAQ index, computed by Vanguard SA securities, rose 23.3 points on the week to 1,640.1. The RASDAQ, which opened last October to eventually trade 5,000 companies privatised under a mass selloff, now lists 2,685 stocks.
It traded an average 338 companies this week.
